title: BestHomes
description: BestHomes is a lightweight and easy-to-use homes plugin designed for simplicity and flexibility.
body:
**BestHomes** is a simple and lightweight homes plugin built for ease of use. It gives players full control over their homes with essential features like setting, deleting, renaming, and moving homes. Designed to stay clean and efficient, it avoids unnecessary complexity while still offering flexibility.

The plugin also includes a fully customizable GUI editor directly in the config, allowing server owners to easily adjust menus and layouts without hassle. It also supports both action bar messages and standard chat messages, giving you the choice of how information is displayed to players. BestHomes is perfect for servers that want a straightforward, reliable home system that just works.

**Version:** 1.21.11

**Installation:** Download the plugin and place it into your server’s `/plugins` folder, then restart or reload your server.

**Updates & Support:** BestHomes is a new plugin and will be actively updated with improvements and new features. Join the Discord for Support!
